moments.title: EFL Season Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 EFL Championship and League One seasons begin this weekend, with Wolverhampton Wanderers hosting Blackburn Rovers in the Championship on Friday, August 14th.

angles.name: Championship Opener
angles.copy: The new EFL season is HERE! Championship kicks off tomorrow night as Wolves take on Blackburn. Who are you backing for promotion this year?

angles.name: League One Starts
angles.copy: It's back! League One action gets underway this Saturday. Get ready for a thrilling season of upsets and promotion battles!

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean Reign Supreme
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' remains at number one on the Official UK Singles Chart for a record-breaking 20th non-consecutive week, closing in on its 21st.

angles.name: Chart History
angles.copy: Still number 1! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' makes chart history with 20 non-consecutive weeks at the top. What an achievement!

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Can 'Rein Me In' make it to 21 weeks at Number 1? Sam Fender & Olivia Dean are absolutely dominating the UK Singles Chart!

angles.name: Ariana's Dominance
angles.copy: Ariana Grande is owning the charts! Two tracks in the Top 4 this week with 'Hate That I Made You Love Me' and new entry 'Petal'.
